predecessors.name: Almoravid dynasty
predecessors.text: Silves and the western Algarve, held by the Almoravids 1091-1145 (infobox), for the second taifa of 1145

successors.name: Taifa of Seville
successors.text: the whole kingdom, conquered by Abbad II in 1063

successors.name: Almohad Caliphate
successors.text: Silves and the western Algarve, 'Conquered by the Almohads: 1150' ('To Morocco: 1150-1250')

ledger.x: 1027: the taifa of Silves is established.
1048: the Banu Muzayn take the throne.
1145: the second taifa of Silves is set up.
1150: the taifa of Silves ends under the Almohads; a third period 1151-1168 that Cliopatria draws is not on the page.

wars.name: Seville's conquest of the taifa of Silves
wars.outcome: 'Under Isa III, the kingdom was conquered by the taifa of Seville, led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid'; Silves was part of Seville until the Almoravids took it over in 1091 (infobox).

wars.name: Muridun revolt in southwestern Iberia
wars.outcome: 'The Muridun staged a major revolt in southwestern Iberia in 1144' under Ibn Qasi, who 'later passed to the Almohads'; the second taifa of Silves follows in 1145.

wars.name: Almohad conquest of Silves
wars.outcome: 'Conquered by the Almohads: 1150' (infobox); the page gives no campaign.

certainty.note: A taifa kingdom whose extent the page does not give beyond Silves and the westernmost Algarve.
The second taifa 1145-1150 is an 'ephemeral' city state; Cliopatria's shape is the only record of its land.
